This folder is VEFX merged into ELE (rebuilt from its released assembly, with small ELE changes marked "(ELE)":
asset/settings paths under GameData/BDArmoryAvionics/VEFX, a weapon-explosion entry point for BDArmory warheads,
and staying off when the standalone mod is installed). The full licence text is in GameData/BDArmoryAvionics/VEFX/LICENSE.
